name: Voice line welcome (EN)
text: Welcome to the Idea Grove!
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line welcome (FR)
text: Bienvenue au Bosquet des idées !
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line move (EN)
text: To walk, tap the ground, or use the round stick.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line move (FR)
text: Pour marcher, touche le sol, ou utilise le rond.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line tapGlow (EN)
text: Tap the glowing things to explore!
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line tapGlow (FR)
text: Touche ce qui brille pour explorer !
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line biomeFrontier (EN)
text: Find the glowing cards. Where does each animal live?
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line biomeFrontier (FR)
text: Trouve les fiches qui brillent. Où vit chaque animal ?
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line chronoQuarter (EN)
text: Find the sparkles, and take each old thing home to its stand.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line chronoQuarter (FR)
text: Trouve les étincelles, et ramène chaque objet ancien à son présentoir.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line skyharbor (EN)
text: Help Bolt the robot bring the gear to the airship!
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line skyharbor (FR)
text: Aide Boulon le robot à apporter l'engrenage au dirigeable !
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line wellDone (EN)
text: Well done!
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line wellDone (FR)
text: Bravo !
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line tryAgain (EN)
text: Good try! Let's try again.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line tryAgain (FR)
text: Bien essayé ! On recommence.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line backGate (EN)
text: Walk through the gate to go back to the grove.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line backGate (FR)
text: Passe la porte pour revenir au bosquet.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line thanks (EN)
text: Thank you for telling us!
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Voice line thanks (FR)
text: Merci de nous l'avoir dit !
notes: ElevenLabs TTS (voice 'sarah') via MEXTY generate_audio; ages 4-6 voice-over.

name: Grove Keeper line greet1 (EN)
text: Hello, young explorer! I am the Grove Keeper.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line greet1 (FR)
text: Bonjour, jeune explorateur ! Je suis le Gardien du bosquet.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line greet2 (EN)
text: Explorers learn by looking closely at living things.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line greet2 (FR)
text: Les explorateurs apprennent en regardant de près les êtres vivants.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line sparks (EN)
text: Find three glowing seeds around the Grove. Drag to look around: one is behind you!
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line sparks (FR)
text: Trouve trois graines qui brillent dans le bosquet. Fais glisser pour regarder autour : il y en a une derrière toi !
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line back (EN)
text: You found them all! Come back to me, by the Idea Tree.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line back (FR)
text: Tu les as toutes trouvées ! Reviens me voir, près de l'Arbre à idées.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line sparksDone1 (EN)
text: Three sparks! You looked everywhere, like a real explorer.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line sparksDone1 (FR)
text: Trois étincelles ! Tu as regardé partout, comme un vrai explorateur.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line sparksDone2 (EN)
text: Here is your Field Camera, and your Field Guide.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line sparksDone2 (FR)
text: Voici ton appareil photo, et ton Guide de terrain.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line frog (EN)
text: Look! A tree frog is sitting on the Biome Frontier stall. Take its photo!
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line frog (FR)
text: Regarde ! Une rainette est assise sur l'étal de la Frontière des biomes. Prends-la en photo !
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line firstPhoto (EN)
text: Your first photo! Its page in your Field Guide is filling in.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line firstPhoto (FR)
text: Ta première photo ! Sa page dans ton Guide de terrain se remplit.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line frontier (EN)
text: Now walk into the Biome Frontier, through its stall.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line frontier (FR)
text: Maintenant, entre dans la Frontière des biomes, par son étal.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line photos3 (EN)
text: Photograph three different creatures there. Walk slowly, or they hide!
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line photos3 (FR)
text: Photographie trois créatures différentes. Marche doucement, sinon elles se cachent !
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line lens (EN)
text: Great photos! Here is a hand lens. Tap a creature near you and count what you see.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line lens (FR)
text: Superbes photos ! Voici une loupe. Touche une créature près de toi et compte ce que tu vois.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line lensStep (EN)
text: Look closely at two creatures with your hand lens.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line lensStep (FR)
text: Observe deux créatures de près avec ta loupe.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line allDone (EN)
text: Wonderful! You are a real field explorer now. Keep filling your Field Guide!
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line allDone (FR)
text: Merveilleux ! Tu es un vrai explorateur de terrain. Continue à remplir ton Guide !
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line welcomeBack (EN)
text: Welcome back, explorer!
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Grove Keeper line welcomeBack (FR)
text: Bon retour, explorateur !
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'antoni'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line toucan (EN)
text: Toucans live in the tropical forests of Central and South America.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line toucan (FR)
text: Les toucans vivent dans les forêts tropicales d'Amérique centrale et du Sud.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line tree-frog (EN)
text: Red-eyed tree frogs live in the rainforests of Central America, near ponds and streams.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line tree-frog (FR)
text: Les rainettes aux yeux rouges vivent dans les forêts tropicales d'Amérique centrale, près des mares et des ruisseaux.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line morpho (EN)
text: Blue morphos live in the rainforests of Central and South America.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line morpho (FR)
text: Les morphos bleus vivent dans les forêts tropicales d'Amérique centrale et du Sud.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line sloth (EN)
text: Sloths live high in the rainforest trees of Central and South America.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line sloth (FR)
text: Les paresseux vivent en haut des arbres des forêts tropicales d'Amérique centrale et du Sud.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line tortoise (EN)
text: Desert tortoises live in the deserts of the south-western United States and Mexico.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line tortoise (FR)
text: Les tortues du désert vivent dans les déserts du sud-ouest des États-Unis et du Mexique.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line horned-lizard (EN)
text: Horned lizards live in dry, sandy and rocky places of North America.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line horned-lizard (FR)
text: Les lézards cornus vivent dans les endroits secs, sableux et rocheux d'Amérique du Nord.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line bighorn (EN)
text: Desert bighorn sheep live on steep, rocky mountains and canyons of the south-western United States and Mexico.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line bighorn (FR)
text: Les mouflons du désert vivent sur les montagnes et les canyons rocheux et raides du sud-ouest des États-Unis et du Mexique.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line saguaro (EN)
text: Saguaros grow only in the Sonoran Desert, in Arizona and in Mexico.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line saguaro (FR)
text: Les saguaros ne poussent que dans le désert de Sonora, en Arizona et au Mexique.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line sea-turtle (EN)
text: Green sea turtles swim in warm oceans all around the world.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line sea-turtle (FR)
text: Les tortues vertes nagent dans les océans chauds du monde entier.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line clownfish (EN)
text: Clownfish live on coral reefs in the warm Indian and Pacific Oceans.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line clownfish (FR)
text: Les poissons-clowns vivent sur les récifs de corail des océans Indien et Pacifique, où l'eau est chaude.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line sea-star (EN)
text: Sea stars live in every ocean of the world, from rocky shores to the deep sea.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line sea-star (FR)
text: Les étoiles de mer vivent dans tous les océans du monde, des rochers du rivage aux grandes profondeurs.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line octopus (EN)
text: Octopuses live in every ocean. Many hide in dens among rocks and coral.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line octopus (FR)
text: Les pieuvres vivent dans tous les océans. Beaucoup se cachent dans des abris entre les rochers et le corail.
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line biomeFrontier2 (EN)
text: Find the creatures and take their photo. Walk slowly, or they hide!
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).

name: Voice line biomeFrontier2 (FR)
text: Trouve les créatures et prends-les en photo. Marche doucement, sinon elles se cachent !
notes: ElevenLabs TTS via MEXTY generate_audio (voice 'sarah'); first expedition (ticket 6addeddaca61b98af27f98ae).
